The spacious rooms enjoy superb views of the Qinhuai River from their spacious hot tub. Hotel guests can enjoy the calm and relaxing ambience of a fusion of contemporary Thai and Chinese décor which give the whole room a warm glow. All come with a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and a hairdryer and offer a double bed. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and Internet access. Furthermore, a safe, a minibar, tea and coffee making facilities and air conditioning are provided in all accommodation as standard. All rooms also feature a terrace.
